Text: WHEN the TillPoint POS sends a purchase event for a member, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for that purchase.
Rationale: Earning starts from the POS purchase event (context.md row 1); points stay pending during the return window.

Text: The loyalty service shall award a member 1 point per SGD 1 of the purchase amount, rounded down per transaction.
Rationale: Earning rule of the programme; the legacy module applies the same rate.

Text: WHILE a bonus campaign is active, the loyalty service shall multiply the points earned on each purchase the campaign covers by the campaign multiplier.
Rationale: Bonus campaigns can multiply earning; which purchases a campaign covers and which multipliers exist are open questions for SH-07.

Text: WHEN 24 hours have passed since a purchase, the loyalty service shall post the pending points of that purchase.
Rationale: Points become usable after the 24-hour return window; whether available and posted are one moment is glossary open question 5.

Text: IF a member returns a purchase within 24 hours of the purchase, THEN the loyalty service shall reverse the pending points of that purchase.
Rationale: A return inside the return window removes points that were never posted.

Text: WHEN a member returns a purchase after its points were posted, the loyalty service shall reverse the posted points of that purchase.
Rationale: Returns reverse the points of the original transaction.

Text: IF a reversal would take a member's points balance below zero, THEN the loyalty service shall TBD.
Rationale: The brief leaves open whether the balance may go negative after a return of redeemed points; the legacy module sets it to zero (CAN-010), which Finance must confirm.

Text: IF the fraud engine places a hold on a purchase, THEN the loyalty service shall keep the points of that purchase pending until the fraud engine releases the hold.
Rationale: LOY-118 asks for held points when the fraud check fails; the fraud engine sends hold and release (context.md row 8).

Text: WHEN the loyalty service receives a purchase event or a redemption request, the loyalty service shall send the event to the fraud engine for scoring.
Rationale: The fraud engine scores earn and redeem events (context.md row 7).

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the loyalty service shall include those points in the points balance it returns to the customer mobile app.
Rationale: LOY-118 asks that the app shows the new balance after a purchase; whether pending points also show is open question 2 in questions-loy-118.

Text: WHEN TBD, the loyalty service shall send the member a push notification with the points earned.
Rationale: LOY-118 asks for a push when points are added; the trigger (pending or posted) is open question 3 and consent is open question 7 in questions-loy-118.

Text: WHEN TBD, the loyalty service shall send the member an email with the points earned.
Rationale: LOY-118 asks for an email as well; the notification provider in context.md sends only SMS and push (open question 1 in questions-loy-118).

Text: IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption request.
Rationale: Programme minimum redemption (CAN-001).

Text: WHEN the loyalty service accepts a redemption, the loyalty service shall issue the member a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 redeemed points.
Rationale: Programme conversion rate (CAN-002, CAN-005); what happens to points below the next 100 is CAN-003, still to confirm.

Text: IF the TillPoint POS requests validation of a voucher that is already applied, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the validation request.
Rationale: A voucher can be applied only once (PRD line 16; voucher state Applied in BRIEF.md:70).

Text: WHILE the fraud engine holds a redemption, the loyalty service shall withhold the voucher of that redemption.
Rationale: PRD line 21 states it; the security architect (SH-05) has not confirmed it.

Text: IF a support agent submits an adjustment without a reason code, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the adjustment.
Rationale: Adjustments need a mandatory reason code (CAN-007).

Text: IF a support agent submits an adjustment of more than 5000 points, THEN the loyalty service shall apply the adjustment only after a second approver approves it.
Rationale: Maker-checker for large adjustments; whether it also covers removals is CAN-008, owner SH-06.

Text: WHEN 12 months have passed since points were posted, the loyalty service shall expire those points.
Rationale: Expiry period of the programme terms draft v3 and Finance's position (BRIEF.md:60); Marketing wants 18 months, and who runs expiry is D-01.

Text: WHEN posted points of a member are TBD days from expiry, the loyalty service shall send the member a points-expiring message through the notification provider.
Rationale: The service sends points-expiring messages (context.md row 9); members complain about expiry without warning (CAN-018).

Text: WHEN a support agent looks up a member in the admin console, the admin console shall display the member's points balance and points history.
Rationale: Support agents look up members in the admin console (context.md rows 11 and 12).

Text: The loyalty service shall send each member's tier and points summary to Relay CRM once per night.
Rationale: Relay CRM receives tier and points summary nightly (context.md row 6); the interface is TBD.

Text: The loyalty service shall deliver a daily points-liability extract to the data warehouse.
Rationale: Finance accounts for the points liability from a daily extract (context.md row 10); its fields are an open question for SH-03.
